memories.author: D05
memories.text: Insomnia, migraine, depression. Patient reports difficulty falling asleep, frequent throbbing headaches, low mood, fatigue. Examination: tired appearance, normal vitals, no focal neurology. PHQ-9 12, ISI 18, TSH 4.2, Hb 13.8. Plan: start melatonin, trazodone, propranolol, sumatriptan, topiramate, naproxen, sertraline; educate on sleep hygiene; follow-up in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Penicillin allergy: rash and pruritus within 30 minutes of oral amoxicillin at age 22. Avoid all beta-lactams.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Still waking 2-3 times night, headaches 4 days/week, feeling down most days. Melatonin helps a bit but trazodone causes morning grogginess.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Insomnia, migraine, depression. Symptoms: sleep onset latency 45 min, headaches 4/week, PHQ-9 14. Exam unchanged. ISI 20 (borderline). TSH 4.1, Hb 13.7, B12 210. Plan: reduce trazodone to 25 mg HS, add mirtazapine 15 mg HS for sleep and depression, keep sertraline 50 mg OD, continue migraine prophylaxis.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Insomnia, migraine, depression. Patient reports improved sleep (latency 20 min), headaches 2/week, mood better. PHQ-9 9, ISI 13. Exam: calm, vitals stable. Plan: continue current meds, consider tapering topiramate if migraine control sustained.
